claims.claim: The paper reports improved global-key and template-based pitch manipulation over its compared methods.
claims.limitations: Music data, pitch range, cycle assumptions, perceptual protocol, and content preservation bound transfer to conversational voice conversion.

claims.claim: The proposal shows how both experimental paradigms can be described within one Bayesian framework.
claims.limitations: This is a theoretical proposal, not an independent behavioral validation; parameterization, priors, and task fit remain open.

claims.claim: On LRS3-TED with DEMAND noise, the paper reports higher LCC than audio-only baselines for PESQ and STOI under seen noise.
claims.limitations: Seen-noise conditions, proxy targets, visual availability, dataset, and correlation metric limit transfer; proxy prediction is not a listener study.

claims.claim: MOVER reports successful combination on CHiME-8 DASR and NOTSOFAR-1 multi-channel tasks.
claims.limitations: Task formats, diarization errors, interval alignment, system diversity, and scoring rules bound transfer; fusion gains do not prove every component is complementary.

claims.claim: NeuroSpex+ reports improved overall signal quality over baselines in the evaluated neuro-guided extraction setting.
claims.limitations: EEG alignment, subjects, mixtures, signal metric, and lab conditions bound transfer; signal quality is not a demonstrated BCI communication benefit.

claims.claim: The paper reports comparable SER performance between models trained on distilled and original emotional-speech data.
claims.limitations: Synthesis method, emotion labels, initialization, privacy threat model, device profile, and test split bound the result; utility parity is not formal privacy.

claims.claim: The paper reports improved intelligibility and speaker similarity in its dysarthric speech reconstruction evaluation.
claims.limitations: Speaker, severity, reference data, perceptual metrics, and diffusion sampling bound transfer; reconstructed speech is not clinical treatment evidence.

claims.claim: Word meaning explains part of tonal variability; after accounting for it, the reported sandhi/citation difference disappears.
claims.limitations: Speaker sample, spontaneous corpus, lexical items, tone context, and statistical model bound transfer; one tone pattern is not the whole Taiwanese system.
